conviction_note: No unpriced company-level number found for Q3 (Jun-Aug). The six findings are proxies, a public price-hike notice, and positioning, and they lean mildly positive (impact_sum +1.3): the H1 plan looks conservative against a street already 2.9% above it, Q3 egg costs came in below the plan's assumption, and the stock went into the print 11% off its September all-time high while analysts were raising targets. But this name sold its last two beats (-4.81% on Q1, -2.45% on H1), both times on the overseas line and a held plan, and that line cannot be checked before the release. So p_up is 55 on a 4.0% scale, giving +0.4. The scaled number is a third of the findings sum because the reaction function vetoes most of the fundamental lean.
bar: FY2026/11 ordinary profit: IFIS consensus 41,171m yen (https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/report?bcode=2809, read 2026-10-08) against a company plan of 40,000m, held at H1 and 2.1% under IFIS then (https://scouter.monex.co.jp/news/detail/2809_20260709_act_20260709_153015_2). Operating-profit plan 38,000m (H1 script, https://www.kewpie.com/ir/pdf/presentation/2026/ir_20260709_FY2026q2_kessansetsumei_script.pdf). print_vs_bar is the FY ordinary forecast after the release against IFIS: -2.8% if the plan is held, which is the base case, and about 0 if it is raised to consensus; the probability-weighted figure is -1.5.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register: 0.0%, no position at or above 0.5%, unchanged (as of 2026-09-29, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, from the baseline). Margin ratio 2.29, a moderate margin long and not crowded. No option skew exists. priced_lean_pct +0.23, mostly the run-up component (20d -8.26%, 5d -2.78%). Price path from https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/2809.T: 4,793 on 9/2 to 4,263 at the 10/8 seal (-11%). Kikkoman fell about 7% and Nissin about 6.5% over the same span, so roughly two thirds of the drop is the sector rotating out of defensives. The ¥10bn buyback finished on 10/2, so the company's own bid is out of the market.

findings.finding: H1 ordinary profit was 21.5bn, 53.8% of the 40.0bn plan against a 5-year average of 48.9%. Holding the plan implies H2 ordinary down 7.3% YoY, and IFIS has 41.17bn. The company revised at Q3 in 2023 (OP +28.6%) and in 2025 (sales only), but held at both Q1 and H1 this year, calling 38.0bn OP 'must-achieve' after building in 4.5bn of Middle East costs, 4.3bn of which fall in H2.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 (2025-10-02): plan held for profit and sales revised up 1.4%; the stock rose 5.22% the next session. H1 2026 (2026-07-09): plan held after an OP beat; the stock fell 2.45%. Q3 2024: no revision; -1.93%. Reactions computed from Yahoo daily closes on the TDnet release dates listed by irbank.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The street number already sits 2.9% above the plan, so a raise to about 41bn is the expectation and only a raise beyond it, or a 9-month progress rate well ahead of the 78% (FY2025) to 87% (FY2024) record, adds anything. If the market were confident of a raise, the stock would not have given back 11% while TP raises came in (JPM 5,000 to 5,800 on 9/2, Mizuho 5,050 to 5,150 on 9/25).
findings.independence: Revision history from https://f.irbank.net/pdf/20231005/140120230929560761.pdf and https://f.irbank.net/pdf/20251002/140120250930565317.pdf (separate documents). The consensus level is from IFIS via kabuyoho. Plan conservatism and Middle East allocation are from the same company script as the bar, so they count once.

findings.finding: Egg prices, Kewpie's key domestic input, averaged about 301 yen/kg over Q3 (Tokyo M base: Jun 308, Jul 303, Aug 292). That is 6-9% below each month a year earlier and just under the plan's FY assumption of 305 yen/kg.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: In H1 the egg-price rise cost 1.2bn of a 1.3bn headwind (H1 script p.6). FY2025's Q3 revision was driven by egg prices, on sales and not profit; the stock rose 5.22% that day.
findings.source_date: 2026-10 (畜産の情報 2026年10月号, August data)
findings.why_not_priced: Partly. The ALIC series is public, but the egg effect has to be translated into Kewpie's domestic margin, and lower egg prices also lower pass-through sales in the egg-processing line. It is a modest tailwind against the plan assumption, not a number the company has disclosed. A proxy, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: Plan assumption of 305 yen/kg from the H1 script (https://www.kewpie.com/ir/pdf/presentation/2026/ir_20260709_FY2026q2_kessansetsumei_script.pdf), a different document.

findings.finding: Nisshin Oillio raised bulk/commercial edible-oil prices 17-21% from June 1 2026, citing the Middle East and US biofuel mandates. Q3 is the first full quarter of that cost for mayonnaise and dressings, against a plan assumption of 427 yen/kg for the bulk (ローリー) oil price (+13.6% YoY).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No line-specific reaction is sourced. The cost was announced on 2026-04-20, before the 2026-07-09 plan reaffirmation that included 4.5bn of Middle East costs.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. It was public before the company re-set its cost allocation in July, so it sits inside the guide. Only the gap between the actual bulk price and the 427 assumption could matter, and that price was not found. Sized toward 0.
findings.independence: snippet_only for the hike magnitudes (logi-today and sbbit pages via search). The plan assumption is from the H1 script.

findings.finding: On 2026-09-01 Kewpie announced price hikes from Nov 1: 224 household items up about 3-25% (mayonnaise 559 to 611 yen) and 601 commercial items up about 2-38%. It cited continuing rises in raw materials, packaging, energy and logistics. The release can quantify the FY2027 effect.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock rose 0.5% on 9/2 to an all-time high on the announcement, then fell 11% over the following five weeks.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced as a headline. What is new at the print is the size of the effect and whether it lets the company hold its plan despite costs. Only one month of it (November) falls in FY2026, so it mostly matters for next-year sentiment.
findings.independence: kabutan/Fisco coverage https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=2809&b=n202609020429 reports the same notice, so it counts once.

findings.finding: The ¥10bn buyback resolved on 2026-01-14 was completed on 2026-10-02 (2,395,100 shares). Kewpie announced its last two buybacks with H1 (2025-07-03) and FY results (2026-01-14), never with Q3, and the H1 script's two-year return target (about 37bn yen, 67% total payout) is already covered.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Jan 2026: a dividend increase plus buyback rose 4.59% (kabutan n202601150347). Jul 2025: the H1 buyback rose 12.09%.
findings.why_not_priced: The base case of no new buyback at Q3 is what the record implies, so it is neutral. The skew is to the upside: management calls returns '機動的' (flexible) and wants ROE at its 8.5% target early, so an unscheduled programme is possible but unlikely.
findings.independence: Announcement pattern from the irbank IR list (https://irbank.net/2809), a separate page. Return policy from the H1 script.

findings.finding: Into the print the stock is 11% below its 9/2 all-time high (4,793 to 4,263), against flat TOPIX and 6-7% falls in food peers. No shorts are disclosed, margin is a moderate 2.29x, and three brokers raised targets since late July (Nikko 5,500, JPM 5,800, Mizuho 5,150, all top rating). Kewpie's prints have bounced when it came in depressed (Q3 2025 +5.2%, FY Jan 2026 +4.6%) and been sold when it came in near highs (Q1 2026 -4.8%, H1 -2.45%).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: See finding: the last four reactions split on the pre-print setup, two up after declines and two down after runs toward highs.
findings.why_not_priced: This is a read of the price itself, so by definition it is about what is priced, not information. It argues the bar is lower than in July, when a beat with a held plan was sold from near the high. Sized small, as positioning; one Japanese case of run-in sizing has already failed (LESSONS open question 4).
findings.independence: Price path from Yahoo chart (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/2809.T?range=3mo&interval=1d). TP raises from kabutan rating digests of 9/2 (n202609020953) and 7/28 (n202607281167).

outside_window.finding: The Nov 1 2026 price hikes (2-38%) feed FY2027 margins and are the basis of the FY2027 guide due in January 2027.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: possible. Q3 revisions came in 2023 (up) and 2025 (sales only); this year the plan was held at Q1 and H1, and IFIS 41.17bn ordinary is 2.9% above plan, so holding is a mild disappointment and the base case. Returns: unlikely at Q3, since past buybacks came with H1 or FY results and the ¥10bn programme just ended. New-year guide: not at this print (FY ends Nov). Quarter against own progress history: H1 progress was 53.8% against a 5-year average of 48.9%; at Q3 the comparison is 9-month OP against 78% (FY2025) and 87% (FY2024) of the final result. A Q3 OP of about 12bn (+10%) gives about 84% of plan.

baseline_tension: The findings agree with the baseline's small positive lean (+0.23, from the -8% run-up) rather than cutting against it. The strongest positive the release could carry is an upward revision toward or above IFIS plus a quantified FY2027 price-hike effect; I looked, and the company's own record makes it possible but not the base case. The strongest negative is a held plan with weak Americas sales, which sold the last two prints. Weighing these, p_up is 55 and the scaled number (+0.4) is well under the findings sum (+1.3).
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on a public series goes toward 0): the edible-oil cost finding rests on a public April price notice and sits inside the July guide, so it moved from -0.2 to -0.1.

Rule 2 (check the sign): the buyback finding moved from -0.1 to 0.0. Having no new programme at Q3 is the base case and already priced, and the asymmetry is to the upside, not a negative. The strongest positive is now named in baseline_tension.
Open question 4 (run-in sizing failed once): the positioning finding stays at +0.5 with a wide band and no larger size. abs_move_pct and p_up were not changed.
